-- Open Corvane lines whose confirmed date is at least 56 days after the requested date.
SELECT i.po_no, i.line_no, m.description,
       i.requested_delivery_date, i.confirmed_delivery_date
FROM purchase_order_item AS i
JOIN purchase_order AS h ON h.po_no = i.po_no
JOIN material AS m ON m.material_no = i.material_no
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT po_no, line_no, sum(qty) AS received_qty
    FROM goods_receipt
    GROUP BY po_no, line_no
) AS r ON r.po_no = i.po_no AND r.line_no = i.line_no
WHERE h.supplier_no = 'V-10017'
  AND h.order_date <= DATE '2026-11-01'
  AND coalesce(r.received_qty, 0) < i.order_qty
  AND i.confirmed_delivery_date >= i.requested_delivery_date + INTERVAL 56 DAY
ORDER BY i.po_no, i.line_no

-- Corvane on-time rate by quarter for receipts in 2025 and 2026.
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM g.receipt_date) AS receipt_year,
       EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM g.receipt_date) AS receipt_quarter,
       COUNT(*) AS receipt_count,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.receipt_date <= i.confirmed_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           / COUNT(*),
           1
       ) AS on_time_pct
FROM goods_receipt AS g
JOIN purchase_order_item AS i ON i.po_no = g.po_no AND i.line_no = g.line_no
JOIN purchase_order AS h ON h.po_no = g.po_no
WHERE h.supplier_no = 'V-10017'
  AND g.receipt_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND g.receipt_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM g.receipt_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM g.receipt_date)
ORDER BY receipt_year, receipt_quarter

-- On-hand RF generators in RM01, the location used for component planning.
SELECT i.plant_code, m.material_no, m.description, i.qty_on_hand
FROM inventory AS i
JOIN material AS m ON m.material_no = i.material_no
WHERE m.description LIKE 'RF generator,%'
  AND i.storage_location = 'RM01'
ORDER BY m.material_no, i.plant_code

-- Open Etch tool sales lines ordered on or before the lab's today.
SELECT i.so_no, i.line_no, c.name AS customer_name,
       m.material_no, m.description, i.qty, i.promised_date
FROM sales_order_item AS i
JOIN sales_order AS h ON h.so_no = i.so_no
JOIN customer AS c ON c.customer_no = h.customer_no
JOIN material AS m ON m.material_no = i.material_no
WHERE i.status = 'Open'
  AND m.material_type = 'TOOL'
  AND m.family_code = 'ETC'
  AND h.order_date <= DATE '2026-11-01'
ORDER BY i.so_no, i.line_no

-- On Databricks, write datediff(DAY, p.planned_start, a.available_date) in place of datediff('day', p.planned_start, a.available_date).
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT m.material_no AS root, m.family_code, b.component_material_no AS material_no,
           CAST(b.qty_per AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS qty, 1 AS level
    FROM material m JOIN bom_item b ON b.parent_material_no = m.material_no
    WHERE m.material_type = 'TOOL'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.root, t.family_code, b.component_material_no,
           CAST(t.qty * b.qty_per AS DECIMAL(20,6)), t.level + 1
    FROM tree t JOIN bom_item b ON b.parent_material_no = t.material_no
    WHERE t.level < 10
), leaves AS (
    SELECT t.root, t.family_code, t.material_no, SUM(t.qty) AS qty
    FROM tree t JOIN material m ON m.material_no = t.material_no
    WHERE m.description LIKE 'RF generator,%'
    GROUP BY t.root, t.family_code, t.material_no
), spare_plant AS (
    SELECT material_no,
           MIN(CASE family_code WHEN 'ETC' THEN 'SC01' WHEN 'CMP' THEN 'SG01'
                                ELSE 'AU01' END) AS plant_code
    FROM leaves
    GROUP BY material_no
), production_need AS (
    SELECT p.prod_order_no, l.material_no, p.plant_code,
           p.planned_start AS need_date, p.qty * l.qty AS qty
    FROM production_order p JOIN leaves l ON l.root = p.material_no
    WHERE p.status IN ('Planned', 'Released') AND p.planned_start > DATE '2026-11-01'
), spare_need AS (
    SELECT i.material_no, sp.plant_code, i.promised_date AS need_date, i.qty
    FROM sales_order_item i JOIN spare_plant sp ON sp.material_no = i.material_no
    WHERE i.status = 'Open' AND i.promised_date > DATE '2026-11-01'
), need_ledger AS (
    SELECT material_no, plant_code, need_date, day_qty,
           SUM(day_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY material_no, plant_code ORDER BY need_date
                              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT material_no, plant_code, need_date, SUM(qty) AS day_qty
        FROM (
            SELECT material_no, plant_code, need_date, qty FROM production_need
            UNION ALL
            SELECT material_no, plant_code, need_date, qty FROM spare_need
        ) needs
        GROUP BY material_no, plant_code, need_date
    ) daily
), outstanding AS (
    SELECT i.po_no, i.line_no, i.material_no, h.plant_code, h.supplier_no,
           i.confirmed_delivery_date, i.order_qty - COALESCE(SUM(g.qty), 0) AS qty
    FROM purchase_order_item i JOIN purchase_order h ON h.po_no = i.po_no
    LEFT JOIN goods_receipt g ON g.po_no = i.po_no AND g.line_no = i.line_no
    WHERE h.order_date <= DATE '2026-11-01'
    GROUP BY i.po_no, i.line_no, i.material_no, h.plant_code, h.supplier_no,
             i.confirmed_delivery_date, i.order_qty
    HAVING i.order_qty > COALESCE(SUM(g.qty), 0)
), stock AS (
    SELECT material_no, plant_code, SUM(qty_on_hand) AS qty FROM inventory
    WHERE storage_location = 'RM01'
    GROUP BY material_no, plant_code
), supply_events AS (
    SELECT material_no, plant_code, supply_date, qty
    FROM (
        SELECT s.material_no, s.plant_code, DATE '2026-11-01' AS supply_date, s.qty
        FROM stock s JOIN material m ON m.material_no = s.material_no
        WHERE m.description LIKE 'RF generator,%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT o.material_no, o.plant_code,
               GREATEST(o.confirmed_delivery_date, DATE '2026-11-01'), o.qty
        FROM outstanding o JOIN material m ON m.material_no = o.material_no
        WHERE m.description LIKE 'RF generator,%' AND o.confirmed_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
    ) events
), supply_ledger AS (
    SELECT material_no, plant_code, supply_date, day_qty,
           SUM(day_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY material_no, plant_code ORDER BY supply_date
                              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT material_no, plant_code, supply_date, SUM(qty) AS day_qty
        FROM supply_events
        GROUP BY material_no, plant_code, supply_date
    ) daily
), availability AS (
    SELECT n.prod_order_no, n.need_date, MIN(s.supply_date) AS available_date
    FROM production_need n
    JOIN need_ledger d ON d.material_no = n.material_no AND d.plant_code = n.plant_code
                      AND d.need_date = n.need_date
    LEFT JOIN supply_ledger s ON s.material_no = n.material_no AND s.plant_code = n.plant_code
                             AND s.cumulative_qty >= d.cumulative_qty
    GROUP BY n.prod_order_no, n.material_no, n.plant_code, n.need_date
)
SELECT i.so_no, i.line_no, c.name AS customer_name, i.promised_date,
       p.planned_start,
       MAX(datediff('day', p.planned_start, a.available_date)) AS days_at_risk
FROM availability a
JOIN production_order p ON p.prod_order_no = a.prod_order_no
JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.so_no = p.so_no AND i.line_no = p.so_line_no
JOIN sales_order h ON h.so_no = i.so_no
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_no = h.customer_no
JOIN material m ON m.material_no = p.material_no
WHERE i.status = 'Open' AND m.material_type = 'TOOL' AND m.family_code = 'ETC'
  AND h.order_date <= DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY i.so_no, i.line_no, c.name, i.promised_date, p.planned_start
HAVING MAX(datediff('day', p.planned_start, a.available_date)) > 0
ORDER BY i.so_no, i.line_no
